251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251902|f56638d6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|f56638d6.text:
Greetings, child. I am Illaya Amberwind and I am the Elder Windshaper here on Zephras Isle. It's always nice to meet young new faces that make their way down from the grove.

Don't let this old shaman hold you up, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Do feel free to stop by later if you'd like.

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256930|341966bb.name: Captured Bandit
256930|341966bb.text:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.

256930|70ce7a83.name: Captured Bandit
256930|70ce7a83.text: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.

256930|b893349b.name: Captured Bandit
256930|b893349b.text: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.

256930|d07034d1.name: Captured Bandit
256930|d07034d1.text: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.

256930|dc9d79f6.name: Captured Bandit
256930|dc9d79f6.text: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.

257018|1a6886aa.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

257024|c65683ed.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

92514-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92514-complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.
92514-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92595-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595-accept.title: The Windshapers

92595-complete.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-complete.text:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.
92595-complete.title: The Windshapers

94411-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
94411-accept.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411-accept.title: Meddlesome Mages
